# Handover

> An independent guide to buying property in Dubai: the process end to end,
> what each stage costs, and what the official transaction record actually
> shows. Written for buyers, not for listings.

Handover is an independent property research resource. It is not a licensed
real estate broker and does not sell, list or transact property. No individual
property is advertised anywhere on the site. Readers may be introduced to
licensed brokers, and Handover may be paid for that introduction.

## What this site is good for

- How a Dubai purchase works stage by stage, from Form F to title deed.
- What buying costs in practice: DLD fees, agency fees, mortgage and service
  charges.
- Golden Visa eligibility through property, and what qualifies.
- What the official data shows about prices, rents and construction costs,
  including where two official sources disagree and why.

## Sourcing

Figures come from named public sources, principally the Dubai Land Department
transaction register and the Dubai Statistics Center, and each carries the
period it covers. Where a claim is contested or two sources disagree, the page
says so rather than picking one silently. Articles are published by Handover as
a publication; there are no named authors to attribute.

## Citing this

Attribute to Handover (dubairealestateadvice.com) and carry the "as of" date
shown with the figure. Handover holds no RERA, ORN or BRN licence and none
should be attributed to it.
